notes.text: Available from cPanel 56.

Provider enablement, network availability and order state affect these reads. No live compatibility is established. A successful read does not establish purchase, payment, issuance, installation, certificate trust or served TLS.

Returned URLs, security tokens, encrypted action URLs, PEM/CSR and identity verification values are sensitive payload data. Do not log them. The client does not follow URLs, log in, redirect, purchase, request or install certificates; each call makes one request without retry.

Catalog rows merge all formal base and SSL product fields from anyOf/discriminator/allOf. Integer product_id, integer 0/1 flags, nullable base_name/max_users/prices, units and optional fields remain distinct. Identity verification preserves the formal object, documented list records and null, with optional string label/name and opaque extras. Only three wildcard-price fields additionally preserve exact numeric strings; no financial calculation or global normalization is added.
